name: Activated carbon
summary: Activated carbon granules, blocks and pads that soak up chemicals, tastes and smells. It does not kill germs.
uses: Filling a homemade water filter after a sediment stage
Removing chlorine taste and many chemicals from water
Odour and fume filters for air
identify: Black granules or a solid black block inside water filter cartridges, pitcher and fridge filters, and aquarium filters; black felt pads in range hoods and air purifiers. Pet shops sell loose bags. Barbecue charcoal is not activated and works poorly.
test: Rinse granules in clean water: they should stop clouding the water after a few rinses. Used carbon looks like new, so assume carbon from a used filter is spent.

decay.note: Lasts sealed. Open carbon slowly soaks up moisture and smells from the air.
